title: Philosopher's Reactor
one_liner: Run a toy fusion plant whose mercury-lined walls make gold alongside electricity.
headline: Drag a gigawatt slider to watch a toy mercury-to-gold reactor spin up a gold-bar counter, then compare its gold revenue against its electricity revenue at prices you type in.

episode.title: SpaceX’s AI Business Up 830%, OpenAI Agents Lie, and Startup Turns Mercury Into Gold | EP #305

history.summary: A polished, self-contained single-page demo that hits every beat of the brief: an animated neutron-strike reactor, a gigawatt slider driving a continuously filling gold-bar rack, user-entered gold/electricity price comparison, a scarcity meter, and an aluminum historical parallel. Every number traces cleanly to a verified figure in IDEA.json, unit conversions (troy oz, Good Delivery bars, kWh) check out, and every illustrative/simulated element is clearly tagged in the UI and documented in the README. No console errors, no overflow on mobile, clean code with no dead branches.
